messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — Elevated gateway timeouts observed across edge-us-east-1 starting ~12:34 UTC. Pager routed to @mira oncall. :warning:

mira: seeing 504s spiking on /v1/generate. Dashboard shows 30% error rate, 95th latency up to 6s. Customers reporting increased latencies. I'm on it.

samir: I see connection timeouts from edge to inference pool nodes, TLS handshakes failing intermittently. Could be nginx upstream health checks.

jia: adding logs: ```
edge-proxy error: upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream
inference-node: kept alive conn reset by peer
```

mira: rolling back last gateway deploy from 12:20 and switching traffic to previous variant now. Requesting a partial rollback via deploy bot.

ops-bot: deploy rollback initiated by @mira — change id 2026-03-15-rollback-01. Expected completion ~30s.

alex: any customer-facing incidents? CS slack thread shows two customers impacted with timed-out requests. cc @jia for correlation.

jia: correlating traces — requests that hit model S-quantized-2.1 show queueing and connection resets; artifact in kernel logs shows OOM-kill on one of the inference pods.

samir: OOMs would explain upstream deaths. Which autoscaler? Dedicated pool autoscaler didn't spike new instances due to pod affinity constraints.

mira: immediate mitigations: 1) scale inference pool count to +3 (manual), 2) disable aggressive batching on gateway for 30m, 3) divert non-critical routes to fallback model. Doing step 1 now.

samir: manual scale applied. pods coming up, but need to tune node memory limits. Suggested hotfix: increase pod memory request to 20Gi and add eviction buffer.

mira: agreed — hotfix patching deployment manifest for inference pool. Pushing patch to canary then prod.

ops-bot: hotfix pipeline triggered by @mira — build/patch/approve steps in progress.

jia: alert noise note: Prometheus alert 'edge_5xx_rate' fired multiple times. Threshold was too sensitive for transient cold starts. Recommend tuning: increase window to 5m and require >= 5 errors.

alex: action: CS to notify impacted customers with ETA. @samir to post root-cause once validated. @mira to update runbook with scaling failure steps.

mira: running through runbook checklist now. Finding step gaps: runbook assumes autoscaler will always be able to provision nodes — need a remediation for affinity constraints and manual scale run commands.

samir: creating PR to runbook: add section 'manual-scale-dedicated-pool' with commands and KMS-safe creds handling. Will link PR.

jia: alert tuning PR: updating Prom rule to `increase_window: 5m`, `min_count: 5`, also add note for detection of OOM-kill patterns. Will submit.

ops-bot: incident status -> mitigation in progress. Next update in 15m or on change.

mira: follow-ups — (1) hotfix merged + deployed, (2) runbook PR (#452) opened, (3) alert tuning PR (#453), (4) postmortem draft to include timeline & customer impact, (5) retro to revisit batch configs. Assigning owners: hotfix @samir, runbook @samir, alerts @jia, postmortem @mira.

alex: thanks team. Quick note for SRE on-call rotation — ensure runbook updates are in docs and new tests for autoscaler. :thumbsup:

samir: will link PRs and set a follow-up meeting for 11am UTC tomorrow.

mira: incident declared resolved at 12:56 UTC — error rate down to baseline, rollback + scale mitigations stable. Closing page but leaving thread for follow-ups.

ops-bot: incident CLOSED by @mira at 12:56 UTC — summary: transient OOMs in inference pods due to affinity constraints preventing autoscaler from replacing unhealthy nodes. Mitigation: manual scale, hotfix memory request, deploy rollback, alert tuning.

mira: filing postmortem, will attach timeline and action items. Thanks everyone.
